races.name: Gowran Park Golf Optional Claiming Race
races.verdict:
LIBERATE has fared better with the draw than at Galway and can provide Denis Hogan with a second successive win in this optional claimer. Mythical Rock rates an obvious threat on the back of his good effort in a handicap last time. Minaun View has a good record in claimers and is next on the list ahead of Ken Condon's Star of Beauty.

  1. LIBERATE
  2. MYTHICAL ROCK (IRE)
  3. MINAUN VIEW

races.name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for several, but CITRUS SPRINGS left her debut effort behind when runner-up at Leopardstown just under 3 weeks ago and with further progress on the cards now fitted in a first-time visor, Joseph O'Brien's filly can make it third time lucky. Her biggest threat may emerge from Not You Too, who found only a bright prospect too strong on debut last month. Debutant Snapequus and Mirren are another couple to also consider.

  1. CITRUS SPRINGS (USA)
  2. NOT YOU TOO (IRE)
  3. SNAPEQUUS (IRE)

races.name: FINAL FURLONG PODCAST WITH 1XBET Handicap
races.verdict:
PRETTY OMAGH GIRL made an emphatic return to action when successful on handicap debut at the Curragh in May and with her subsequent effort there easy to strike a line through (coughed), Andy Oliver's filly gets the nod to resume her progress. It's no surprise to see cheekpieces discarded from Little Empire and he looks the biggest threat, with recent C&D winner Alfred Tennyson taken to fill out third.

  1. PRETTY OMAGH GIRL (IRE)
  2. LITTLE EMPIRE (IRE)
  3. ALFRED TENNYSON (IRE)

races.name: Darley Irish EBF Hurry Harriet Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
races.verdict:
MOONLIT SUN did well to get so close 3 fellow last-time-out winners granted the trip she endured at Galway and Jessica Harrington's filly is fancied to successfully make the step up to listed company. Skydance has to respected on the back of her Ascot third, with the reliable Lemsairbat completing the shortlist.

  1. MOONLIT SUN (IRE)
  2. SKYDANCE
  3. LEMSAIRBAT (FR)

races.name: McEnery Cup Handicap
races.verdict:
NAVY WATERS is in better form than her recent form figures suggest and can get off the mark for the season if avoiding the trouble she has met on her last couple of starts. Star Harbour had excuses last time and is feared most on the strength of his Carlisle effort in June, while Dallas Star is respected on handicap debut having raced almost exclusively at a higher level.

  1. NAVY WATERS (IRE)
  2. STAR HARBOUR (IRE)
  3. DALLAS STAR (FR)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
races.verdict:
GLIONDAR made a promising start when runner-up at the Curragh in June, closing all the way to the line, so he is taken to go one better as he moves up in trip. Karrygrant has run well when placed on his last 2 outings and could be the main danger, ahead of Socratea.

  1. GLIONDAR (FR)
  2. KARRYGRANT (IRE)
  3. SOCRATEA (IRE)

races.name: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
KEILAH threatened to come good more than once in this sphere last year and is taken to belatedly get the job done, with fitness assured and a useful 5 lb claimer booked. Connova has also been knocking on the door and rates the main danger, particularly if getting the race run to suit, while Perfect Judgement and La Campanella are respected.

  1. KEILAH (IRE)
  2. CONNOVA (IRE)
  3. PERFECT JUDGEMENT (IRE)
  4. LA CAMPANELLA (IRE)

races.name: 1XBET IRISH SPIRIT Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
THEGOOSEISCOOKED won this race last year and, having taken a step back in the right direction when third at Navan 32 days ago, is fancied to repeat the feat from a 2 lb lower mark. Nibras Rainbow has won twice in his last 5 starts and ran at least as well when third at Ballinrobe last time, so is feared most, while Miss Crinshawn and Nephin Mountain are respected back in 0-60 company.

  1. THEGOOSEISCOOKED (IRE)
  2. NIBRAS RAINBOW (IRE)
  3. MISS CRINSHAWN (IRE)
  4. NEPHIN MOUNTAIN (IRE)

races.name: Michael Brunton Memorial British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks a much easier assignment for EASY ANSWER than the Coventry at Royal Ascot and he gets the vote, although a strong market move for newcomers Forbidden Fire, Flick Of An Eye and /or Saturn Star would put a slightly different slant on things.

  1. EASY ANSWER (IRE)
  2. FORBIDDEN FIRE
  3. FLICK OF AN EYE (IRE)

races.name: Frazier Jones Wine Merchants Handicap
races.verdict:
There should be more to come from the lightly-raced REGIONAL ROCK and he's narrowly preferred to the thriving Supreme King. This is a bit easier than the races So Darn Hot has been contesting and he's next on the list.

  1. REGIONAL ROCK
  2. SUPREME KING (IRE)
  3. SO DARN HOT

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Stonehenge Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
Charlie Appleby has a strong record in this race and QUEST FOR STARS, who seems sure to benefit from the step up to 1m, is taken to remain unbeaten. Glorious Goodwood maiden winner Rafe's Da Man may give the selection most to think about ahead of sole filly Scommessa Sicura.

  1. QUEST FOR STARS (FR)
  2. RAFE'S DA MAN
  3. SCOMMESSA SICURA (IRE)

races.name: Molson Coors Pembroke Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
REMI MAE can make up for last month's Nottingham demotion by taking this. Bold Shout remains open to progress and looks the chief threat unless the betting speaks strongly in the favour of his stablemate Annie Sioux on debut, who has Tom Marquand in the saddle.

  1. REMI MAE
  2. BOLD SHOUT (IRE)
  3. ANNIE SIOUX (IRE)

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Upavon Fillies' Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
races.verdict:
FELICITAS has been freshened up since the Prix de Diane and is taken to bounce back to form with the Ed Walker team in very good order. The chief threat may come from fellow 3-y-os Miss Scott, a promising sort from last year's winning stable, and On Message.

  1. FELICITAS
  2. MISS SCOTT (IRE)
  3. ON MESSAGE

races.name: Champagne Joseph Perrier Handicap
races.verdict:
Oisin Murphy is an interesting booking for FOX AVATAR, who had an excuse last time and is back on a good mark. The Kubler stable is going well so the reliable Londoner is second choice ahead of Almekarem, who ought to benefit from the return to 1¼m.

  1. FOX AVATAR (IRE)
  2. LONDONER (IRE)
  3. ALMEKAREM (IRE)

races.name: Faucets The Bathroom Specialists Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ESKIMO PIE may have had plenty of chances to get her head in front, but she's been ambitiously campaigned and this looks a gilt-edged opportunity for Jane Chapple-Hyam's filly to get off the mark. Heading up the dangers is Mollstar, who showed promise late last year and is best excused her handicap debut back in December. Mystic Veil is an interesting newcomer.

  1. ESKIMO PIE (IRE)
  2. MOLLSTAR
  3. MYSTIC VEIL

races.name: Birthday Boy Leighton Happy 80th Handicap
races.verdict:
SHEIK YERBOUTI left previous efforts behind when third in a Wolverhampton maiden a couple of months ago and with the form of that race working out, Grace Harris' charge gets the tentative nod to make a winning start in handicaps. The Coffee Pod finished closer than previously for his current yard last time, so he heads up the opposition, with Dark Sun and Happier taken to fight out third.

  1. SHEIK YERBOUTI
  2. THE COFFEE POD (IRE)
  3. DARK SUN

races.name: Meyer Timber EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
NARRJOO shaped well when runner-up in a Doncaster novice on debut, beaten only by a useful-looking prospect, and he can build on that effort to go one better. Drum Bay also made a positive start when second at Lingfield last month and is feared most, ahead of Isabella de Vega.

  1. NARRJOO (IRE)
  2. DRUM BAY
  3. ISABELLA DE VEGA (IRE)

races.name: Dandara Homes Handicap
races.verdict:
NAMMOS wasted no time getting back to form at Chepstow last month and she is taken to record a second success since joining her current yard this spring. She gets the vote ahead of Ivat Ghia, who found some progress when runner-up on her handicap debut at Leicester, with Angel's Call also a contender.

  1. NAMMOS
  2. IVAT GHIA (IRE)
  3. ANGEL'S CALL (IRE)

races.name: Golwg Gwendraeth 'Confined' Handicap
races.verdict:
ROYAL BODYGUARD rates just the pick of the weights on the back of a resurgent Newmarket fourth (form been franked) so edges the vote from Alan King's in-form maiden John Harrison. Handicap debutant Brave New World appeals as a likely improver and could also play a prominent role.

  1. ROYAL BODYGUARD (IRE)
  2. JOHN HARRISON
  3. BRAVE NEW WORLD (IRE)

races.name: Dress For The Occasions Handicap
races.verdict:
A DAUGHTERS LOVE spreadeagled her rivals over C&D last week and is impossible to side against turned out under a penalty. Hat-trick seeking Belle of Kt appeals as the one to chase home David Flood's improver ahead of Meet Me In Meraki.

  1. A DAUGHTERS LOVE
  2. BELLE OF KT
  3. MEET ME IN MERAKI

races.name: Macan At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Those with experience don't set the bar too high, so MUGHEER, a well-bred newcomer from a family his excellent yard knows well, could be up to doing the business on debut. Lexington Boom should give another good account, while Ard As A Rock is of interest dropping to the minimum trip given the speed he's shown.

  1. MUGHEER (IRE)
  2. LEXINGTON BOOM
  3. ARD AS A ROCK (IRE)

races.name: 911 At Porsche Centre Hull EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Hugo Palmer's COCO NOVA shaped with promise when a debut fourth at Doncaster last month and with that form having been well advertised since he looks the way to go. Real Edition can play a big part and is next on the list, while Empire Rising can also have a say now stepping up in trip. Quintillion and You Got Know How look the pick of the newcomers and the betting should be revealing.

  1. COCO NOVA (IRE)
  2. REAL EDITION (IRE)
  3. EMPIRE RISING (IRE)

races.name: Clearanswer Call Centres Handicap
races.verdict:
Not as competitive as the numbers suggest and 2024 victor KING SHARJA is fancied to bounce back in style and gain a fourth C&D success from a handy-looking mark with his yard going really well. The New Bay Pearl has also slipped in the weights and could emerge as the main danger ahead of Alice's Influence and Sir David.

  1. KING SHARJA
  2. THE NEW BAY PEARL
  3. ALICE'S INFLUENCE

races.name: Jill Willows Handicap
races.verdict:
ALPHA CAPTURE looked unlucky not to double his tally for 2026 when runner-up in a Chester claimer last time and can make amends off a lenient-looking mark now back in handicap company. Bell Shot took this contest in 2024 and is feared most on the back of a good Pontefract second, although in-form duo Tattie Bogle and Homestrait can also play a prominent role in this competitive handicap.

  1. ALPHA CAPTURE (IRE)
  2. BELL SHOT (IRE)
  3. TATTIE BOGLE

races.name: Cayenne Electric At Porsche Centre Hull Handicap
races.verdict:
A few with chances but it could pay to side with course specialist DR RIO who signalled he is ready to strike again here when fifth over C&D (form working out well) last time and can edge out recent Newcastle scorer Bearwith. In-form duo Sunny Orange and Princess Niyla also enter the reckoning in this competitive handicap.

  1. DR RIO (FR)
  2. BEARWITH
  3. SUNNY ORANGE (IRE)

races.name: Nation Radio Yorkshire Handicap
races.verdict:
ANGEL NUMBERS hasn't looked back since joining Ruth Carr and is fancied to defy a 6 lb penalty for her stylish Ripon victory and go 3-3 for her new handler. Qila is feared most on the back of a resurgent Thirsk third after a breathing operation, with Straight Ahead and Simba's Pride also well in the mix.

  1. ANGEL NUMBERS (IRE)
  2. QILA
  3. STRAIGHT AHEAD

races.name: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
COAXED is out of the Queen Elizabeth II Stakes winner Persuasive and can overcome stall 11 to give Baaeed his first winner as a sire. Marsala produced a promising debut effort at Newbury and sets the standard of those with experience, whilst newcomers Sweltering and Miss Miniver also have plenty to recommend them on paper.

  1. COAXED
  2. MARSALA (IRE)
  3. SWELTERING

races.name: Unibet/Breeders Backing Racing EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
MANAAR has a penalty to defy but looks a useful prospect and can resume winning ways upped further in trip. Arrivera is going the right way and can improve further for the longer trip so could give her most to think about.

  1. MANAAR (IRE)
  2. ARRIVERA
  3. LUNELLA (IRE)

races.name: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
DAPPER GUEST has struggled like most from his yard this year, but there's been better signs of late from the stable and he could bounce back returned to his favoured surface having eased in the weights. Cogitate is also well treated now and not long with his current trainer so he could go well, while Percy's Lad could take some pegging back from a handy draw if on a going day.

  1. DAPPER GUEST (IRE)
  2. COGITATE (IRE)
  3. PERCY'S LAD

races.name: Unibet Support Safer Gambling Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
METAL MERCHANT served warning that he's ready to strike when coming fourth down in grade at Newcastle last time and his stable's relentless good form this summer means he's well worth chancing to get the better of the rock-solid Chalk Mountain. Kiniro and Kitaro Kich are also appealing back on all-weather.

  1. METAL MERCHANT (IRE)
  2. CHALK MOUNTAIN
  3. KINIRO

races.name: Bet 20 Get 20 With Unibet Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
GREY SOUL has won 2 of his 3 starts for Dan Horsford and the progressive son of Dark Angel is fancied to complete the hat-trick. Stardancer is still low mileage and should remain competitive after a 3 lb rise for his Chepstow win, whilst Warrior Mode looked like he'd got himself back on track when third on his recent Newmarket return.

  1. GREY SOUL (IRE)
  2. STARDANCER (IRE)
  3. WARRIOR MODE

races.name: Bet 20 Get 20 With Unibet Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
ROGUE ALLEGIANCE appeals as one the James Owen yard should get the best out of and a 4 lb rise for his recent Yarmouth win may underestimate him. Final Night arrives in good form and is a very solid proposition at this C&D, with Sovereign View also making the shortlist.

  1. ROGUE ALLEGIANCE (IRE)
  2. FINAL NIGHT
  3. SOVEREIGN VIEW

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
KOKBASTAU is lightly raced with just 3 runs to his name and is really well bred so looks just the type to go on improving now handicapping up against much more exposed rivals. The Green Mile scored here last time and should be a player from 6 lb higher, while Bulletin never runs a bad race.

  1. KOKBASTAU
  2. THE GREEN MILE (IRE)
  3. BULLETIN (IRE)

races.name: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap
races.verdict:
A winner over hurdles in Ireland in April, CROOKED PATH has since joined a yard which has an excellent record with new recruits and he looks to be on a workable mark back on the Flat. He gets the vote ahead of Solanna, who isn't taken lightly in his current form, with Semper Femina completing the shortlist.

  1. CROOKED PATH (IRE)
  2. SOLANNA
  3. SEMPER FEMINA (IRE)

Prix De Jouy En Josas - Attele
Prix De La Porte De Passy - Attele
Prix De La Porte De Versailles - Attele
Prix Du Pont De L'alma - Attele
